**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/25 (Thu) 12:12  
[FACT] User has a doll collection that currently stands at 37 pieces.  
[EVENT] User received a package from Japan containing a limited-edition Sailor Moon figurine.  
[PREFERENCE] User is planning to display the Sailor Moon figurine alongside other anime-inspired collectibles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on their new addition and offered to help create a spreadsheet to organize the doll collection.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided a suggested template for a Doll Collection Inventory Spreadsheet with the following columns: ID, Name, Type, Brand/Manufacturer, Series/Collection, Release Date, Acquisition Date, Description, Condition, Display Status, Notes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided an example row for the spreadsheet, including details for a Sailor Moon figurine.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested tips for organizing the collection, including using a unique ID, tracking condition, and using Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel.  
[EVENT] User decided to use Google Sheets for their spreadsheet.  
[EVENT] User mentioned they have a mix of vintage and limited edition dolls and want to estimate the total value for insurance purposes.  
[EVENT] User acquired a vintage 1960s Barbie doll last weekend, which is in mint condition with its original packaging and accessories.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on their vintage Barbie doll find and provided guidance on calculating the total value of the collection.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant suggested adding columns for Estimated Value, Source, and Value Type to the spreadsheet.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided an updated example row for the spreadsheet, including details for the vintage Barbie doll.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained how to calculate the total value using the SUM function in Google Sheets.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for estimating values, including researching online marketplaces and consulting collector forums.  
[EVENT] User expressed interest in organizing their vinyl record collection.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant offered to help create a spreadsheet for the vinyl record collection.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided a suggested template for a Vinyl Record Collection Spreadsheet with the following columns: ID, Artist, Album Title, Release Date, Label, Catalog Number, Format, Condition, Sleeve Condition, Value, Source, Notes, Genre.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided an example row for the vinyl record spreadsheet, including details for The Beatles' Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained how to calculate the total value of the vinyl record collection using the SUM function.  
[PREFERENCE] User has a mix of rock, jazz, and classical
